title: ACT VII
subtitle: The Emberfall Peaks
rewardRelicDesc: Your units gain +2 ATK at battle start whenever your base HP is below 50%.

intro.title: THE EMBERFALL PEAKS
intro.text:
The ley lines cut through the mountains here — through layers of volcanic rock still warm from the last eruption. This is the Emberfall Peaks: a chain of active volcanoes that the Fracture cracked open and left to simmer.

Things live here. Heat-adapted things. Things that were dangerous before the Fracture made them angrier.

The ley path goes through the caldera. There's no route around.

intro.title: THE CINDERWARLORD
intro.text:
The Peaks are held by the Cinderwarlord — a commander who built an army out of whatever the volcanoes threw up: crawlers, hounds, archers who fire molten shot, constructs assembled from cooled lava-flow.

He has not lost the mountains once. The mountains are on his side. Literally. He has an understanding with them.

You are going to walk through his territory regardless.

intro.title: HEAT AND PRESSURE
intro.text:
The deeper you go, the hotter it gets. The ley lines are visible here — they glow faintly orange, like metal near a forge, and they point straight toward the caldera at the heart of the range.

Whatever is at the Fracture Core, the ley lines think this is the way.

You have learned to trust the ley lines. You have also learned to bring extra water.

outro.title: THE CINDERWARLORD FALLS
outro.text:
The Cinderwarlord does not retreat. He stands in the caldera as the ground cracks around him, and he waits for the mountain to finish the job.

The mountain does not finish the job.

He concedes the terrain with the precision of someone who has done it once before and always swore he wouldn't do it again.

outro.title: WHAT HE SAID
outro.text:
'You shouldn't be able to fight in this heat,' he said.

You told him you'd had practice.

'That's not the point,' he said. He seemed genuinely bothered by the logistics of it.

outro.title: DEEPER IN
outro.text:
The Magma Core sits in your hand — a solid chunk of volcanic glass with something still burning at the centre. The Cinderwarlord's mark of command.

The ley lines glow brighter past the caldera. Whatever the Fracture Core is, it's warmer on this side.

You move forward. The mountains stop objecting.

cinder-approach.label: Cinder Approach
cinder-approach.description: The first ridge. Crawler swarms patrol the ash fields below the treeline.

ash-shrine.label: Ash Shrine
ash-shrine.description: A crude shrine of blackened stone. Hot ash still spirals around it. Something listens.

eventConfig.title: The Ash Shrine
eventConfig.description: A ring of fused volcanic rock, still warm. Ash coils upward in slow spirals — too slow for the wind to explain. Whatever was worshipped here, something is still paying attention.

lava-camp.label: Cooled Flow Camp
lava-camp.description: A solidified lava shelf, sheltered and warm. Not comfortable exactly, but out of the wind.

ember-bazaar.label: Ember Market
ember-bazaar.description: A scavenger who trades in things salvaged from the cooled lava fields. Surprisingly well-stocked.

magma-ford.label: Magma Ford
magma-ford.description: A crossing over a slow lava channel. The Cinderwarlord's regulars hold the far bank.

volcanic-battery.label: Volcanic Battery
volcanic-battery.description: Artillery emplacements built into the crater wall. Magma vents power the launchers.

cinder-vent.label: Cinder Vent
cinder-vent.description: A pressurised vent blasts heat and debris skyward. Things get caught in the updraft.

eventConfig.title: The Cinder Vent
eventConfig.description: A tall fissure blasting superheated gas and cinder into the sky. Debris from destroyed structures up the slope gets caught in the column and circles endlessly. Some of it is still useful.

pools.consequence: A rare card caught mid-flight

pools.label: Reach into the column
pools.consequence: The heat is a balm — healed 15 HP

pools.label: Reach into the column

pyroclast-elite.label: Pyroclast Guard
pyroclast-elite.description: The Cinderwarlord's elite shock troops. They charge through the hot zones without flinching.

caldera-gate.label: Caldera Gate
caldera-gate.description: The entrance to the caldera. The Cinderwarlord's main garrison blocks the pass.

forge-log.label: The Forge Post
forge-log.description: An abandoned command post near the caldera rim. Still has equipment inside.

eventConfig.title: The Forge Post
eventConfig.description: A Cinderwarlord field post, evacuated in the fighting. Forge tools, tactical slates, and a map of the caldera. The slate shows the Cinderwarlord's actual position — and something he marked 'signal origin' in the deep caldera.

pools.label: Study the tactical slates
pools.consequence: Useful knowledge — rare card

pools.consequence: The supply caches are marked — +25 crystals

pools.label: Use the forge rest area

pools.label: Use the forge rest area

crater-rest.label: Crater Shelter
crater-rest.description: A shallow alcove cut into the crater wall. Surprisingly calm.

summit-elite.label: Cinderwarlord's Vanguard
summit-elite.description: The Cinderwarlord's personal guard. They've been briefed on you specifically.

cinderwarlord.label: The Cinderwarlord
cinderwarlord.description: Commander of the Emberfall Peaks. He and the volcanoes have an understanding.
bossDialogue: You walked through my mountains. I respect that. I'm still going to end this.
The volcanoes do what I tell them. You should factor that into your strategy.
I've held this caldera for eleven years. You won't take it in one afternoon.
